verses.en: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, had bought sweet spices, that they might come and anoint him.
verses.pt: Havendo passado o sábado, Maria Madalena, e Maria mãe de Tiago, e Salomé, compraram especiarias, para irem o ungir.
verses.en_web: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.
verses.en_bbe: And when the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene and Mary, the mother of James, and Salome, got spices, so that they might come and put them on him.

verses.en: And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.
verses.pt: E de manhã muito cedo, o primeiro dia da semana, vieram ao sepulcro, ao nascer do sol.
verses.en_web: Very early on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.
verses.en_bbe: And very early after dawn on the first day of the week, they came at the time of the coming up of the sun to the place where the body had been put.

verses.en: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?
verses.pt: E diziam umas às outras: Quem rolará para nós a pedra da porta do sepulcro?
verses.en_web: They were saying among themselves, “Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?”
verses.en_bbe: And they were saying among themselves, Who will get the stone rolled away from the door for us?

verses.en: And when they looked, they saw that the stone was rolled away: for it was very great.
verses.pt: Pois era muito grande. E quando observaram, viram que já a pedra estava havia sido rolada;
verses.en_web: for it was very big. Looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back.
verses.en_bbe: And looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back; and it was of great size.

verses.en: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed in a long white garment; and they were affrighted.
verses.pt: e entrando no sepulcro, viram um rapaz sentado à direita, vestido com uma roupa comprida branca; e elas se espantaram.
verses.en_web: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe, and they were amazed.
verses.en_bbe: And when they went in, they saw a young man seated on the right side, dressed in a white robe; and they were full of wonder.

verses.en: And he saith unto them, Be not affrighted: Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth, which was crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.
verses.pt: Mas ele lhes disse: Não vos espanteis. Vós buscais a Jesus Nazareno crucificado. Ele já ressuscitou, não está aqui. Eis aqui o lugar onde o puseram.
verses.en_web: He said to them, “Don’t be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen. He is not here. Behold, the place where they laid him!
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, Do not be troubled: you are looking for Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been put to death on the cross; he has come back from the dead; he is not here: see, the place where they put him!

verses.en: But go your way, tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.
verses.pt: Porém ide, dizei a seus discípulos e a Pedro, que ele vai adiante de para a Galileia; ali o vereis, como ele vos disse.
verses.en_web: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.’”
verses.en_bbe: But go, say to his disciples and to Peter, He goes before you into Galilee: there you will see him, as he said to you.

verses.en: And they went out quickly, and fled from the sepulchre; for they trembled and were amazed: neither said they any thing to any man; for they were afraid.
verses.pt: Então elas, saindo apressadamente, fugiram do sepulcro, porque temor e espanto as haviam tomado; e não disseram nada a ninguém, porque tinham medo.
verses.en_web: They went out, and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had come on them. They said nothing to anyone; for they were afraid.
verses.en_bbe: And they went out quickly from the place, because fear and great wonder had come on them: and they said nothing to anyone, because they were full of fear that ...

verses.en: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.
verses.pt: E havendo ressuscitado pela manhã, no primeiro dia da semana, Jesus apareceu primeiramente a Maria Madalena, da qual havia expulsado sete demônios.
verses.en_web: Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.
verses.en_bbe: Now when he came back from the dead early on the first day of the week, he went first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had sent out seven evil spirits.

verses.en: And she went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
verses.pt: Ela se foi, e anunciou aos que estiveram com ele, que estavam tristes e chorando.
verses.en_web: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
verses.en_bbe: She went and gave news of it to those who had been with him, while they were sorrowing and weeping.

verses.en: And they, when they had heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, believed not.
verses.pt: Quando ouviram que ele estava vivo, e que havia sido visto por ela, eles não creram.
verses.en_web: When they heard that he was alive, and had been seen by her, they disbelieved.
verses.en_bbe: And they, when it came to their ears that he was living, and had been seen by her, had no belief in it.

verses.en: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them, as they walked, and went into the country.
verses.pt: E depois ele apareceu em outra forma a dois deles, que estavam indo pelo caminho ao campo.
verses.en_web: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them, as they walked, on their way into the country.
verses.en_bbe: And after these things he was seen in another form by two of them, while they were walking on their way into the country.

verses.en: And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they them.
verses.pt: E estes foram anunciar aos outros; mas também não creram neles.
verses.en_web: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn’t believe them, either.
verses.en_bbe: And they went away and gave news of it to the rest; and they had no belief in what was said.

verses.en: Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat, and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen.
verses.pt: Finalmente ele apareceu aos onze, estando eles sentados juntos; e repreendeu pela incredulidade e dureza de coração deles, por não terem crido nos que já o haviam visto ressuscitado.
verses.en_web: Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table, and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they didn’t believe those who had seen him after he had risen.
verses.en_bbe: And later he was seen by the eleven themselves while they were taking food; and he said sharp words to them because they had no faith and their hearts were hard, and because they had no belief in those who had seen him after he had come back from the dead.

verses.en: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
verses.pt: E disse-lhes: Ide por todo o mundo, pregai o Evangelho a toda criatura.
verses.en_web: He said to them, “Go into all the world, and preach the Good News to the whole creation.
verses.en_bbe: And he said to them, Go into all the world, and give the good news to everyone.

verses.en: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.
verses.pt: Quem crer e for batizado será salvo; mas quem não crer será condenado.
verses.en_web: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.
verses.en_bbe: He who has faith and is given baptism will get salvation; but he who has not faith will be judged.

verses.en: And these signs shall follow them that believe; In my name shall they cast out devils; they shall speak with new tongues;
verses.pt: E estes sinais seguirão aos que crerem: em meu nome expulsarão demônios; falarão novas línguas;
verses.en_web: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;
verses.en_bbe: And these signs will be with those who have faith: in my name they will send out evil spirits; and they will make use of new languages;

verses.en: They shall take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.
verses.pt: pegarão serpentes com as mãos; e se beberem algo mortífero, não lhes fará dano algum; porão as mãos sobre os enfermos, e sararão.
verses.en_web: they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will in no way hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover.”
verses.en_bbe: They will take up snakes, and if there is poison in their drink, it will do them no evil; they will put their hands on those who are ill, and they will get well.

verses.en: So then after the Lord had spoken unto them, he was received up into heaven, and sat on the right hand of God.
verses.pt: Então o Senhor, depois de haver lhes falado, foi recebido acima no céu, e sentou-se à direita de Deus.
verses.en_web: So then the Lord, after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven, and sat down at the right hand of God.
verses.en_bbe: So then the Lord Jesus, after he had said these words to them, was taken up into heaven and took his seat at the right hand of God.

verses.en: And they went forth, and preached every where, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word with signs following. Amen.
verses.pt: E eles saíram e pregaram por todas as partes, com o Senhor operando com eles, e confirmando a palavra com os sinais que se seguiam. Amém.
verses.en_web: They went out, and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.
verses.en_bbe: And they went out, preaching everywhere, the Lord working with them, and giving witness to the word by the signs which came after. So be it.
